subject: sepulcra
title: Render budget on the iGPU: M3 exit runs and visual parity
note: M3 exit proof runs on the Intel iGPU (Lex rules, 1280x720, desktop apps open) after the render-budget lane: point lights skipped out of range, a 4-tap shadow early-out, the sky ray from the vertex stage and FXAA reading luma from alpha took the boss wave from 5.1 to 4.2 GPU ms. The colossus close-ups are the same paused frame before and after the change (visual parity checked by sight-skeptic).

images.caption: Busy wave (wave 6, 18 enemies), uncapped run: GPU p95 7.0 ms, pacing p95 14.3 ms
Boss wave: GPU p95 5.0 ms, pacing p95 11.7 ms
The same frame after: AO, shadows and FXAA unchanged to the eye
